headline: Pressure grows on Michael Carrick as Man United draw at Leeds
description: Michael Carrick's future as Manchester United's head coach was thrown into fresh doubt on Sunday as his team were held to a 1-1 draw at Leeds United.

headline: Premier League live updates: Leeds host Man United in rival clash
description: Leeds United take on Manchester United in one of England's most heated rivalries as another day of European soccer is underway.

headline: Brighton beat Crystal Palace as Diego Gómez scores longest-range Premier League goal since 2017
description: Diego Gómez has written his name into the history books with a stunning goal on Sunday.

headline: Chelsea's Emi Martínez has jaw surgery, will be 'back in a few weeks'
description: Emi Martínez said he would be "back in a few weeks" after undergoing surgery following a head injury suffered during Chelsea's Premier League win over Everton on Saturday.

headline: Dejan Kulusevski set to return to Tottenham squad after 526-day injury absence
description: Dejan Kulusevski will return to Tottenham's matchday squad for the first time in more than 500 days for Monday's visit of Coventry.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Could Viktor Gyökeres leave Arsenal in January?
description: Arsenal forward Viktor Gyökeres could leave the club in January, while Manchester United are looking to bolster their squad in January. Transfer Talk has the latest.
